notes: «قال مسلم وسمعت» is the compiler's own speech: the tool adds him, the first written name is the shaykh
«يقول لرجل» places a man in the scene only: not a link; «أبا إسماعيل» is the address to Hammad inside the story, not a name in the chain
«سمعت حماد بن زيد» makes Hammad the last link: his words are the saying
